theme.description: Premium Casino Analytics Dashboard. A sophisticated, dark-first UI blending high-end casino aesthetics with dense, functional dashboard data. Focuses on matte charcoal surfaces, subtle glassmorphism, and restrained electric gold and emerald accents.

rules: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all major headings and score numbers.
Use Manrope for body text, labels, and explanations.
Use JetBrains Mono for specific math formulas or poker hand strings.
Apply tracking-tight to headings and tracking-widest to uppercase overlines.
No pure black or white for structural elements.
Use primary (gold) sparingly for main CTA and highest premium recommendations.
Use success/warning/danger for framework scoring and validation statuses.
Playing cards must have a white background for physical realism and high contrast against the dark UI.

shadows: Soft ambient glows for active states (e.g., gold glow around a premium recommendation).
No harsh drop shadows on dark mode; use 1px inner borders (e.g., border-t border-white/10) to define edges.
textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main background to reduce digital flatness.
Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-900/50) for sticky panels or overlays.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-zinc-800 on all cards and bento grid items.

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Brand logo, title, and validation status stack (pills).

sections.name: Card Selector (Hero)
sections.description: Prominent top section displaying 4 selectable playing cards. Use a horizontal flex layout with generous spacing. Add an 'Evaluate' and 'Reset' button here.

sections.name: Dashboard Grid
sections.description: A 3-column bento grid for desktop. Column 1 & 2: Decision Summary & Framework Classes. Column 3: Teaching / Scoop Potential.

sections.name: Decision Summary Panel
sections.description: Massive typography for recommendation (Play/Fold), accompanied by a large score grid.

sections.name: Framework Classes
sections.description: A 2x2 grid of metric cards (L, H, F, R). Use progress bars or segmented blocks to visualize levels (e.g., 3 out of 4).

rules: Use Framer Motion for playing card entrance animations (staggered flip or slide in).
Hover states on buttons should include a slight scale (scale-105) and border glow.
Number counters for the score should animate on evaluation.

components.playing_card: A bespoke component mimicking a physical card. Must have rounded-xl, shadow-lg, and crisp typography for rank/suit.
components.status_pill: Small rounded-full badges with dot indicators for validation (e.g., '4 cards selected').
components.metric_card: Dashboard widget for framework classes. Minimalist, with the value clearly highlighted in the respective color (green/yellow/red).
components.recommendation_chip: A large, bold display element indicating the final decision. Should use a gradient text or intense glow for 'Premium' hands.

rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='card-selector-slot-1').
Focus states must be highly visible (e.g., ring-2 ring-gold).

images.usage: Use this as a very low opacity (5%) background image behind the main dashboard to add a premium casino atmosphere, masked with a radial gradient so it fades into black at the edges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page interactive dashboard using React, Tailwind, and Shadcn UI.
Implement the full Omaha8 4-card selection logic (handling Rank, Suit, uniqueness validation).
Do NOT use basic HTML <select> for cards; build a custom popover or modal selector using Shadcn components.
Construct the Bento grid exactly as described: highly dense, data-rich, yet readable through stark contrast and ample inner padding (p-6 or p-8 inside cards).
Cards should pop visually against the dark theme. Ensure they have white backgrounds with standard red/black suits.
Include teaching elements clearly: math equations should use a monospace font.
Integrate Framer Motion for smooth state transitions when evaluating hands.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, card slots, and score displays.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use default centered layouts. Left-align dashboard content.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters for floating elements.
Use sonner for toasts (e.g., 'Invalid hand selected').
Prioritize optical alignment and generous spacing (p-6, p-8) over cramped default paddings.
